description: Zébullo – Stations de vélos en libre-service à Reims is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Zébullo. Données regroupant les informations du service de vélos en libre-service Zébullo, opéré par Champagne Parc Auto pour le compte de la Ville de Reims et du Grand Reims. Coverage: Zébullo. The publisher named on the listing is Zébullo. Its keywords include deplacement, reims, zebullo, velo, grand-reims, transport. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2025-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
